body:
Approved implementation plan (auto-approved gate, epic #99 autonomous run)

Design: new table site_policy_events (UNIQUE(agent_id, domain); decision, source, matched_domain, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, decision_changed_at, hit_count; FK agents ON DELETE CASCADE; no migration needed). Module src/site-policy-events.js: record() upserts in a transaction, flips decision in place, bumps hit_count; emits 'changed' only on created / decision_changed / verdict_changed; never throws. Hook: _recordPolicyEvent() called after each isAllowed in mcp-handler _enforceSitePolicy (both checkpoints; chain steps covered); popup null-agent checks not logged; IP/localhost raw hosts logged but marked non-actionable. Retention: 30 days on last_seen_at + 5,000-row cap, swept at boot and hourly. Read API GET /api/ui/sites/events (agentId, decision, limit, cursor; joins active agents; exposes agentKey/agentName, actionable, agentRuleDecision). Actions POST /api/ui/agents/:agentId/site-events/allow|revoke with {domain}: create per-agent allow / block via setAgentOverride (revoke always writes block; overwrites a same-domain allow in place, never deletes); do not touch the event row (it flips on the agent's next request). WS event site_policy_events_changed. Routes live in src/site-policy-events-routes.js for HTTP-level tests.

Sub-tasks:
- [sub-task 1] Schema + site-policy-events module + unit tests + EXPECTED_TABLES (complex)
- [sub-task 2] mcp-handler hook + gate stub + end-to-end gate test (standard) — after 1
- [sub-task 3] Routes module + HTTP tests + server.js wiring (mount, WS bridge, retention timer) (complex) — after 1
- [sub-task 4] web-ui api.js wrappers getSiteEvents / allowSiteForAgent / revokeSiteForAgent (light)
- [sub-task 5] CHANGELOG Added entry (light)
- [sub-task 6] Final verification incl. booted-daemon smoke (standard) — last

Flagged for #104: source CHECK value 'agent_override' and the agent_site_overrides join must be renamed in lockstep (needs a table rebuild or drop); UI should refetch on sites_changed and site_policy_events_changed and use agentRuleDecision for the immediate state after an action.
